Application Data.NAME: Smith Construction Group
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith Construction Group specializes in providing general contracting services for both residential and commercial projects. Our operations encompass ground-up construction, extensive renovations, and site preparation for various types of buildings. We pride ourselves on maintaining a strong safety culture and adhering to rigorous safety protocols to mitigate risk. Our team utilizes a network of vetted subcontractors to help manage project demands while ensuring compliance with all necessary regulations and safety standards. Our commitment to quality craftsmanship and timely project delivery has established long-standing relationships with our clients and a reputation for excellence in the construction industry.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, during a commercial renovation project, a worker suffered a fall from a scaffold resulting in a workers' compensation claim totaling $10,000. The claim is currently under review. Additionally, on August 10, 2023, a subcontractor damaged a neighboring property while operating equipment, resulting in a property damage claim of $5,000, which has been settled. Total losses incurred this year amount to $15,000.
